evidence.outcome: Create metadata insert compensates by removing moved backup; prune uses tombstone moves and rollback on metadata failure

next_slice.summary: Run final independent QA for save/backup lifecycle after atomicity hardening.

result: Hardened backup creation and retention atomicity. Indexed-file insertion failure now removes the moved backup file. Retention pruning moves files to recoverable tombstones, restores them when metadata deletion fails, and preserves tombstones if final cleanup fails rather than silently losing state.
